responsibility: C++-specific UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer instrumentation helpers, focused on class vptr correctness. It decides when vptr checks are applicable, inserts IFN_UBSAN_VPTR calls around member calls, member accesses, downcasts, and virtual-base casts, and initializes vtable pointers to null during construction paths so misuse of incompletely initialized polymorphic objects can be detected by the sanitizer runtime.
